title: Rework hook boundary clarification to avoid overstating S1-S5 integration
instructions:
Rework the S5.5 boundary clarification. The previous candidate commit 73a28cb8e74e99f5636211ac003a641fdd091f2b was not accepted because it still slightly overstated S1-S5 behavior by saying hook run evidence is recorded with the Samantha run. S1-S5 added optional hookEvidence support to run logs/readers, but did not integrate hook execution into run-task, worker-dispatch, CLI, or lifecycle flows. You may use git cherry-pick --no-commit 73a28cb8e74e99f5636211ac003a641fdd091f2b as a starting point, then make the correction below. Do not commit from the worker; Samantha will commit after gates pass.

Modify only references/initiatives/samantha-hook-system.md. Preserve the useful boundary clarification from the previous candidate: V1 hooks are reviewed repo artifact commands, not an untrusted plugin sandbox; context injection is bounded but not a repo file-read sandbox; hook commands run from repo root; OS-level read sandbox, strict file-read allowlists, MCP, remote/plugin, and daemon/watch behavior stay future capabilities; write prohibition remains a product rule enforced today through mutation evidence and trust-gate fail-closed behavior.

Required rework: any Current V1 Guarantees / Run Evidence language must not imply hooks are already executed during Samantha run-task or worker-dispatch. Say that S1-S5 provides the optional run-log shape/readers for hook evidence when supplied, or that hook evidence can be recorded by Samantha core once integration supplies it. Keep the distinction between implemented runner APIs and not-yet-integrated runtime dispatch clear.

Verification must pass: bun test tests/hooks.test.ts and bun run typecheck.
